_description: This scenario scripts a model response for the production-bootstrap test.
Coder reaches the model fixture through its real configured provider API.
The first response requests the execute tool advertised by Coder.
The requested command runs inside the actual Nexus workspace.
It checks that the repository contains the deliberately broken value 41.
It invokes the real OpenFlows binary copied by the production startup script.
It emits a marker only after those workspace checks succeed.
The fixture requires that marker in the matching actual tool result.
Only then does the fixture return its final assistant response.
The driver also checks the tool exit code and output independently.
This checks bootstrap execution and does not claim a completed issue or merge.

bootstrap-canary.text: The production workspace executed the bootstrap canary.
